<thought>We need a template that removes a t‑butyldimethylsilyl (TBS) protecting group, i.e., breaks the Si–O bond of a TBS ether and generates an aliphatic hydroxyl. The available functional‑group list includes “t-butyldimethylsilyl” for the group being removed and “aliphatic hydroxyls” for the group formed. Using these terms should retrieve the appropriate retrosynthetic template(s).</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "O[C@H]1C[C@@H](O[C@@H]([C@@H]1C)/C=C(CO)/C)C/C=C/C=C/C(O)=O",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["t-butyldimethylsilyl"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["aliphatic hydroxyls"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
